Maya: FYI I opened a PR to update SDK streaming snippets to the new cursor API + retry semantics (PR #4523). Need quick sanity pass for Py/TS/Go + fix two broken links to pagination and streaming pages.

Dan: I can take Go + TS. Link to PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4523. Question: should we explicitly document stop_on_eof vs cursor end?

Sahil: Runtime changed partial-stream errors so clients should resume with an idempotency token. I'll add a short note and a resume example.

Elena: I'll run the examples locally. Maya which model did you validate with? small vs xlarge differ due to KV cache.

Maya: Validated with redwood/conv-v1 + long-context flag. Repro steps in the PR. Found two 404s: /guides/pagination and /sdk/python/streaming.

docs-bot: CI: docs build failed on link-check. /sdk/python/streaming -> 404. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/4523 :warning:

Dan: I'll fix the pages and push follow-up. For Go I replaced Stream() loop with StreamCursor(), commit a1b2c.

Sahil: Proposed Python resume pattern (pseudo):
# pseudo-client resume pattern
with client.stream(..., cursor=True) as s:
  for chunk in s:
    try:
      process(chunk)
    except TransientError:
      s.retry_with_token(token_id)
Use idempotency tokens on resume to avoid duplicates.

Elena: Local runs green for TS + Py after Dan's change. TS nit: switched from await stream.next() to for await (const part of stream) to avoid race during backoff.

Maya: I'll squash + rebase, add migration note explaining cursor vs old streaming, link runtime retry policy, and fix the two broken links.

Dan: LGTM. Need final wording/style review (tone + code style) before merge tomorrow.

Sahil: Doing quick technical review now (~30m). Prefer canary merge if CI passes.

docs-bot: CI: link-check passed; build: success. docs-publish scheduled. :tada:

Maya: Thanks all. I'll add changelog and a tiny example app in examples repo to show resume+retry patterns.
